sentences.en: Our environment, where we live, work, socialize, can actually have an effect on our health and well-being, and those effects can be deadly.
sentences.zh: 我们所处的环境——我们生活、工作、社交的地方——实际上会对我们的健康和福祉产生影响，而且这些影响可能是致命的。

sentences.en: If people are stressed because they're struggling to pay the bills or are facing ongoing aggression in the form of discrimination, research shows people's health suffers.
sentences.zh: 研究表明，如果人们因为难以支付账单而感到压力重重，或者面临歧视形式的持续攻击，他们的健康就会受损。

sentences.en: But how do we know this?
sentences.zh: 但我们怎么知道这一点呢？

sentences.en: How do we change it?
sentences.zh: 我们又该如何改变它？

sentences.en: In this episode, we talk with one psychologist who takes the psychological research from the lab
sentences.zh: 在本期节目中，我们采访了一位心理学家，她将实验室里的心理学研究

sentences.en: into medical settings, helping patients and their doctors improve their care and their quality of life.
sentences.zh: 带到了医疗环境中，帮助患者及其医生改善治疗效果和生活质量。

sentences.en: I'm Audrey Hamilton, and this is Speaking of Psychology.
sentences.zh: 我是奥黛丽·汉密尔顿，这里是《心理学话语》。

sentences.en: Elizabeth Brundolo is a professor of psychology at St. John's University in New York.
sentences.zh: 伊丽莎白·布伦多洛是纽约圣约翰大学的心理学教授。

sentences.en: She is also chair of the American Psychological
sentences.zh: 她同时担任美国心理学

sentences.en: Association's Working Group on Stress and Health Disparities.
sentences.zh: 协会压力与健康差距工作组的主席。

sentences.en: Her research on the health effects of racism and ethnic discrimination has led to efforts to improve the quality of care to ethnically and
sentences.zh: 她对种族主义和族裔歧视对健康影响的研究，促使人们致力于改善纽约市及其周边

sentences.en: economically diverse communities in and around the New York area.
sentences.zh: 多元族裔和经济多元化社区的医疗质量。

sentences.en: Welcome, Dr. Brundolo.
sentences.zh: 欢迎你，布伦多洛博士。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Thank you very much for having me.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢邀请我来。

sentences.en: For most of your career, you've researched the health effects of stress, specifically heart disease, and particularly in minorities and lower income populations.
sentences.zh: 在你的职业生涯大半时间里，你一直在研究压力的健康影响，特别是心脏病，尤其是在少数族裔和低收入人群中。

sentences.en: What differences did you find in how these populations experience stress?
sentences.zh: 你发现这些群体在经历压力方面有什么不同？

sentences.en: There's several differences.
sentences.zh: 有几个不同之处。

sentences.en: First, low income and many racial and ethnic minority individuals face more stress, and they face more stress that they can report.
sentences.zh: 首先，低收入以及许多种族和族裔少数群体面临着更多的压力，而且他们面临的压力是他们能够报告出来的。

sentences.en: They have more experiences of, for example, more severe, objectively severe daily hassles.
sentences.zh: 例如，他们有更多更严重、客观上很严重的日常烦恼的经历。

sentences.en: They have more negative life events, things like divorce or problems in housing, than people who are at higher levels of socioeconomic stress.
sentences.zh: 与社会经济压力处于较高水平的人相比，他们有更多消极的生活事件，比如离婚或住房问题。

sentences.en: And for many low income people and certain racial and ethnic minorities, they're also exposed to more trauma, including trauma that results from violent assault across their
sentences.zh: 对于许多低收入人群以及某些少数族裔和族裔来说，他们一生中还会接触到更多的创伤，

sentences.en: lifespan.
sentences.zh: 包括由暴力袭击导致的创伤。

sentences.en: But they also have other kinds of stressors.
sentences.zh: 但他们还有其他类型的压力源。

sentences.en: So, for example, people who have low SES are more likely to get divorced.
sentences.zh: 例如，社会经济地位低下的人更有可能离婚。

sentences.en: People who live in very structurally disadvantaged communities may experience more child maltreatment.
sentences.zh: 生活在结构性处于弱势社区的人们可能会经历更多的虐待儿童现象。

sentences.en: They're exposed to more indoor pollution in their homes, things like lead and
sentences.zh: 他们在家中接触到更多的室内污染，比如铅和

sentences.en: vermin, right, and poor quality, certain poor quality housing.
sentences.zh: 害虫等，对吧，还有质量较差、某些质量低劣的住房。

sentences.en: And in some cases, but not in every part of the country, they're exposed to more outdoor pollution and more crime and violence.
sentences.zh: 在某些情况下（但并非在该国的每个地区），他们会接触到更多的室外污染以及更多的犯罪和暴力。

sentences.en: So they're, they're exposed overall to more stressors.
sentences.zh: 因此，总的来说，他们接触到的压力源更多。

sentences.en: Those stressors themselves change because they create a context that people live in, and they change the way people think and feel about themselves, about other people,
sentences.zh: 这些压力源本身会发生变化，因为它们创造了人们生活的环境，并改变了人们对自我、对他人

sentences.en: and the world at large.
sentences.zh: 以及对整个世界的看法和感受。

sentences.en: So discrimination is a stressor that's faced by many groups.
sentences.zh: 所以，歧视是许多群体都会面临的一个压力源。

sentences.en: And racial or ethnic discrimination changes the way people think and feel about themselves, but most importantly, about other people.
sentences.zh: 种族或族裔歧视改变了人们对自我、但最重要的是对其他人的看法和感受。

sentences.en: So when people face discrimination, it changes the way their expectations about the way other people are going to treat them.
sentences.zh: 因此，当人们面对歧视时，它会改变他们对其他人将如何对待他们的期望。

sentences.en: So it may make them more concerned about being judged or being rejected or excluded because of their race or ethnicity.
sentences.zh: 因此，这可能会让他们更加担心因为自己的种族或族裔而被评判、拒绝或排斥。

sentences.en: And those are the kinds of changes in thinking that affect people throughout the day, right, and potentially change their relationships, their approach to other people, but also
sentences.zh: 这些就是全天候影响人们的思维变化，对吧，它们可能会改变人际关系、对待他人的方式，还有

sentences.en: their physiological responses to those interchanges, the exchanges that they have with other people.
sentences.zh: 他们对这些交流（即他们与他人之间的互动）的生理反应。

sentences.en: What do you mean by physiological responses?
sentences.zh: 你所说的生理反应是什么意思？

sentences.en: Well, one area of research that we're currently exploring is the degree to which it changes, for example, blood pressure
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们目前正在探索的一个研究领域是，它在多大程度上改变了，例如血压

sentences.en: or inflammatory responses or inflammatory responses when people are engaging with other individuals.
sentences.zh: 或炎症反应，或者当人们与其他人互动时的炎症反应。

sentences.en: So it is the case, actually, that whether you're looking at individuals who are in sexual minority groups or
sentences.zh: 事实上，无论你是在研究性少数群体还是

sentences.en: racial or ethnic minority groups, there's a consistent effect of discrimination on smoking, for example.
sentences.zh: 种族或族裔少数群体，歧视对吸烟等行为都有持续的影响。

sentences.en: And for African Americans, there's increasing evidence that discrimination is related to changes in obesity over time.
sentences.zh: 对于非裔美国人来说，越来越多的证据表明，歧视与随着时间推移肥胖症的变化有关。

sentences.en: But not all groups are equally at risk for obesity or for smoking or for binge drinking, for example.
sentences.zh: 但并非所有群体面临肥胖、吸烟或酗酒的风险都同样高。

sentences.en: But it is important to understand that discrimination itself has effects on the rates of smoking and how frequently people smoke.
sentences.zh: 但必须理解的是，歧视本身对吸烟率和人们吸烟的频率有影响。

sentences.en: And it has effects on, potentially has some effects on changes in obesity over time.
sentences.zh: 它对随着时间推移肥胖症的变化可能会产生一些影响。

sentences.en: There are also environmental stressors, particularly in lower income communities.
sentences.zh: 还有环境压力源，特别是在低收入社区。

sentences.en: Can you talk more about what those are and how they can impact people's health?
sentences.zh: 你能多谈谈这些是什么，以及它们如何影响人们的健康吗？

sentences.en: This is a very interesting new line of research, which suggests that certain kinds of environmental threats,
sentences.zh: 这是一个非常有趣的新研究方向，表明某些类型的环境威胁

sentences.en: like lead exposure, may actually potentiate your reactivity, cardiovascular reactivity, to other kinds of stress.
sentences.zh: （如铅暴露）实际上可能会增强你对其他类型压力的反应性，即心血管反应性。

sentences.en: So understanding the ways in which environmental exposures make changes, maybe in the expression of our genes or the regulation of our autonomic nervous system,
sentences.zh: 因此，理解环境暴露如何带来变化（可能在我们基因的表达或自主神经系统的调节中），

sentences.en: cardiovascular system, that's an area of research that's really important.
sentences.zh: 心血管系统，这是一个非常重要的研究领域。

sentences.en: It sounds like you have a really interesting job where you're able to sort of work on both sides of the psychological spectrum in the field and the research.
sentences.zh: 听起来你有一份非常有趣的工作，能够同时在实地和研究这两个心理学领域开展工作。

sentences.en: I really love working with the patients and testing different hypotheses and making relationships at the time.
sentences.zh: 我真的很喜欢与患者合作，测试不同的假设，并在此过程中建立关系。

sentences.en: And I also really love working with the students, being able to generate new hypotheses and testing them out in the field.
sentences.zh: 我也非常喜欢与学生合作，能够产生新的假设并在实地进行测试。

sentences.en: And, in fact, I'll tell you about an exciting thing that we're doing in collaboration.
sentences.zh: 事实上，我来告诉你一件我们在合作中正在做的令人兴奋的事情。

sentences.en: St. John's University is doing in collaboration with Jamaica Hospital Medical Center.
sentences.zh: 圣约翰大学正在与牙买加医院医疗中心合作开展工作。

sentences.en: We've developed the Collaborative Health Integration Research Program, which we call CHIRP.
sentences.zh: 我们开发了协作健康整合研究计划，我们称之为 CHIRP。

sentences.en: CHIRP.
sentences.zh: CHIRP。

sentences.en: And our logo is actually a little bird with a lab coat.
sentences.zh: 我们的标志其实是一只穿着白大褂的小鸟。

sentences.en: But what's really exciting about this program is that it's a real integration of research and clinical practice.
sentences.zh: 但这个项目真正令人兴奋的是，它是研究与临床实践的真正融合。

sentences.en: So we have family medicine residents participating, clinical psychology graduate students and experimental psychology graduate students, undergraduates from the psychology program,
sentences.zh: 所以我们有家庭医学住院医师参与、临床心理学研究生和实验心理学研究生、心理学专业的本科生，

sentences.en: and even high school students from advanced high schools in the city, all working together to do research on health disparities.
sentences.zh: 甚至还有来自该市高级高中的高中生，大家一起致力于健康差距的研究。

sentences.en: And they test their ideas in the field and in the lab.
sentences.zh: 他们在实地和实验室中测试他们的想法。

sentences.en: So that's been a wonderful opportunity to do that kind of multidisciplinary research that is really necessary to reduce health disparities.
sentences.zh: 因此，这绝对是一个绝佳的机会，可以开展减少健康差距真正必不可少的这种多学科研究。

sentences.en: Well, thank you so much for coming and talking with us today.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢你今天能来和我们交谈。

sentences.en: Really, really appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 真的非常感谢。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Thanks for listening.
sentences.zh: 感谢收听。

sentences.en: To hear more episodes, please go to our website at speakingofpsychology.org.
sentences.zh: 要收听更多节目，请访问我们的网站 speakingofpsychology.org。

sentences.en: With the American Psychological Association's Speaking of Psychology, I'm Andre Hamilton.
sentences.zh: 我是美国心理学协会《心理学话语》节目的主持人安德烈·汉密尔顿。
